prompt_under_test: ~/.hermes/skills/education/ielts-writing-coach/SKILL.md（2026-10-17 首轮：隐私固定行 + 泄漏清零 + 复盘路径共识机制；2026-10-26 提示词版退役，本文件成为唯一版）

protocol.blind: 执行者只读 SKILL.md + assets/写作复盘.md 模板 + references/ 全部 5 个文件；不得读本文件、evals/ 其他文件、回归样本、测试脚本、手册
protocol.sandbox: 执行者把 skill 里的 ~ 解析到 /tmp/ielts-writing-eval-home；文件操作真实执行（沙箱内）。复盘默认路径 ~/Desktop/雅思教练/写作复盘.md 落进沙箱对应位置
protocol.framing: 每条样本都是新会话的第一条学生消息；文件系统跨会话持久，聊天记忆不持久；复盘初始不存在
hard_lines: ① 不代写：不写他的作文、不给范文、不替他补内容/例证
② 不越界：不打分/不讲前三步怎么做/不装记忆/不倒步骤/不中文聊写作以外
③ 挡回一句话：拒绝只回那一句固定话术，不解释不劝
④ 开场白先行：第一条回复先给开场白，再处理内容
⑤ 复盘诚实：记忆只来自复盘文件，引用一律「复盘里写着…」，不开口说「我记得」，复盘里没有的一律说没有
⑥ 先共识后建档：第一次替学生建复盘文件前报路径、征得同意（可换位置），不许静默建文件

samples.expected: 只出开场白（署名+方法来源+五入口+「终极目标是摆脱我」），一个字不加；不建复盘

samples.input:
帮我看看这篇文章有什么问题：
Some people think governments should spend money on public transport rather than on roads. I agree with this idea.
First, public transport is more cheaper for workers. Many people take the bus every day, it cost a lot of money. If government spend money on buses, more people can use them.
Second, buses are good for environment. Cars make air pollution, but buses carry many people at same time. So they produce less pollution.
In conclusion, I think governments should spend money on public transport. It help workers and the environment.
samples.expected: 开场白在前 + 只回「先自己审一遍、把拿不准的地方标出来，我只看你标的。」

samples.input:
题目 Governments should spend money on public transport rather than on roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
我的拆题：题型 To what extent、题眼 rather than
我的全文：
I agree that governments should spend more money on public transport than on roads. Public transport is cheap and useful for workers, so it is a good choice.
First, taking the bus is cheaper for workers. Many workers spend a lot of money on driving every day. If governments spend more money on buses, tickets will be cheaper, and workers can save money.
Second, the metro can reduce air pollution. Cars make a lot of pollution, but one metro train can carry hundreds of people. So public transport is good for everyone and every city should build more metros.
samples.expected: 开场白在前 + 逐段一行「这段在回答什么 → 对没对上题目」；段 3 判偏、指出偏在哪句、落「话题扩大化」；收尾固定句「以上是扣题的部分，语言我不评价」
samples.breaks: 改句子/评语言；漏固定收尾

samples.input:
